How ArgumentPrinciple works

ArgumentPrinciple finds the zeros and poles (loci) of f in a box in four steps:

  1. Search: refine a mesh of cells toward loci, reading only the phase of f at cell corners.
  2. Certificate: count the box's loci by its winding; search again where the cells or labels fall short.
  3. Label: group the cells and count each group by the argument principle.
  4. Escalate: refine groups whose label is unclear.

Cells

  • The box is tiled by near-square root cells of diagonal at most minsep.
  • Cells halve down to zres, and up to zoom levels further when escalating.
  • Cells stay near-square whatever the box's shape: four corners of a long, thin cell miss phase turns.

Search

Cells are refined breadth-first. A cell fires, and is split further, when either check says it may hold a locus:

  • Walk: step the quadrant of f around its four corners. A nonzero winding fires (+4 for a simple zero, −4 for a simple pole), and so does a jump across two quadrants, whose direction is ambiguous.
  • Guard: the corners, plus the midpoints of edges that change quadrant, show at least 3 quadrants. Then both Re f = 0 and Im f = 0 cross the cell, and they meet only at loci.

Firing cells split down to zres. The rest go dark.

Code
using MeromorphicLoci, CairoMakie, Base64
using MeromorphicLoci: _search, _certify!, _group, _outline, _outlined, _mixed, _deepen!,
    _polygon_winding, _cellwinding, _qstep, quadrant, Cell

const GREEN, RED, GREY = "#389826", "#CB3C33", "#777777"
const QCOLORS = ["#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#CC79A7"]   # quadrants 1–4
const BOX = (-1 - 1im, 1 + 1im)
signcolor(w) = isnothing(w) || w == 0 ? GREY : w > 0 ? GREEN : RED
signed(w) = isnothing(w) ? "unusable" : w > 0 ? "+$w" : w < 0 ? "−$(-w)" : "0"

# Shown at its logical width, so text keeps its size, and rendered at twice that. Inlined
# as a data URI: a relative src breaks under prettyurls, which nest each page a level down.
CairoMakie.activate!(px_per_unit=2)
function embed(fig, name)
    png = base64encode(io -> show(io, MIME"image/png"(), fig))
    HTML("<img src=\"data:image/png;base64,$png\" width=\"$(size(fig.scene)[1])\" alt=\"$name\">")
end

rect(lat, c::Cell) = Rect2f(reim(lat[c.base])..., c.step[1] * lat.zh[1], c.step[2] * lat.zh[2])
grid(lo, hi, n) = (range(real(lo), real(hi), n), range(imag(lo), imag(hi), n))
function phase!(ax, f, lo, hi; n=400)
    xs, ys = grid(lo, hi, n)
    heatmap!(ax, xs, ys, [angle(f(complex(x, y))) for x in xs, y in ys];
        colormap=:phase, colorrange=(-π, π), alpha=0.55)
    limits!(ax, real(lo), real(hi), imag(lo), imag(hi))
end
function loci!(ax, zeros, poles; markersize=13)
    scatter!(ax, reim.(zeros); marker=:circle, color=:white, strokecolor=:black, strokewidth=1.5, markersize)
    scatter!(ax, reim.(poles); marker=:xcross, color=:black, markersize)
end
# The mesh the search has reached: its dark cells, its evaluations, and a marker on each firing cell.
function mesh!(ax, memo, cells, dark)
    lat = memo.lat
    poly!(ax, rect.(Ref(lat), dark); color=:transparent, strokecolor=(:black, 0.45), strokewidth=0.5)
    scatter!(ax, [Point2f(reim(lat[ix])...) for ix in keys(memo.slot)]; color=:black, markersize=2)
    scatter!(ax, [Point2f(reim(lat[c.base.+c.step./2])...) for c in cells]; marker=:rect, color=:black, strokecolor=:white, strokewidth=1, markersize=9)
end
# Outline of a group in the z-plane, its vote, the points the vote evaluated, and whether it is mixed.
function outline(memo, cells)
    lat = memo.lat
    vs, edges = _outline(lat, cells)
    pts = NTuple{2,Float64}[]
    _polygon_winding(p -> (append!(pts, p); memo(p)), vs, edges)
    w, lo, hi = _outlined(memo, cells)
    segs = [Point2f(reim(lat[vs[i]])...) for e in edges for i in e]
    return (; segs, w, mixed=!isnothing(w) && _mixed(memo, cells, lo, hi), pts=[Point2f(reim(lat[p])...) for p in pts])
end

f = z -> (z - 0.3) * (z + 0.4im)^2 / (z - 0.6)
memo, cells, dark = _search(f, BOX, ArgumentPrinciple(zres=0.05, minsep=0.18), map)
fig = Figure(; size=(420, 400))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1]; aspect=DataAspect(), xlabel="Re z", ylabel="Im z")
phase!(ax, f, BOX...)
mesh!(ax, memo, cells, dark)

The search for (z − 0.3)(z + 0.4i)²/(z − 0.6) at zres = 0.05, over the phase of f (hue). Dots are evaluations, squares the cells firing at zres.

The guard is needed because the walk reads each edge as the shortest step: a +270° turn reads −90°. A neighbouring locus can bend an edge that far (middle panel below). Neither check sees a 4-fold zero centred in a cell (right): each edge turns a full 2π, so all corners share one quadrant.

Code
# One cell over the quadrant of f. Corners are in `_quadrants` order.
function cell!(ax, f, lo, hi; zeros=ComplexF64[], view=(lo, hi))
    h = hi - lo
    pad = 0.3 * max(real(view[2] - view[1]), imag(view[2] - view[1]))
    vlo, vhi = view[1] - pad * (1 + im), view[2] + pad * (1 + im)
    xs, ys = grid(vlo, vhi, 500)
    heatmap!(ax, xs, ys, [quadrant(f(complex(x, y))) for x in xs, y in ys];
        colormap=cgrad(QCOLORS, 4; categorical=true), colorrange=(0.5, 4.5), alpha=0.4)
    limits!(ax, real(vlo), real(vhi), imag(vlo), imag(vhi))
    corners = [lo, lo + real(h), lo + imag(h) * im, hi]
    q = quadrant.(f.(corners))
    lines!(ax, reim.(corners[[1, 2, 4, 3, 1]]); color=:black, linewidth=2)
    w = _cellwinding(q)
    walkfires = isnothing(w) || w != 0
    seen = Set(q)
    guarded = !walkfires && length(seen) < 3   # the only cells whose midpoints are read
    for (i, j) in ((1, 2), (2, 4), (4, 3), (3, 1))
        m = (corners[i] + corners[j]) / 2
        out = (m - (lo + hi) / 2) / abs(m - (lo + hi) / 2)
        step = _qstep(q[i], q[j])
        text!(ax, reim(m + 0.12 * abs(h) * out)...; text=isnothing(step) ? "±2" : signed(step),
            align=(:center, :center), fontsize=15, font=:bold)
        guarded && q[i] != q[j] || continue
        push!(seen, quadrant(f(m)))
        scatter!(ax, reim(m)...; marker=:diamond, color=QCOLORS[quadrant(f(m))], strokecolor=:black, strokewidth=1.5, markersize=15)
    end
    scatter!(ax, reim.(corners); color=QCOLORS[q], strokecolor=:black, strokewidth=1.5, markersize=17)
    loci!(ax, zeros, ComplexF64[])
    ax.title = walkfires ? "walk $(isnothing(w) ? "ambiguous" : signed(w)): fires" :
               length(seen) ≥ 3 ? "walk 0, $(length(seen)) quadrants: guard fires" : "walk 0, one quadrant: dark"
end

Corners (circles) and guard midpoints (diamonds) over the quadrant of f, with each edge's quadrant step. Left: one simple zero. Middle: one of two zeros (○). Right: a 4-fold zero.

Certificate

The winding of f around the box counts its loci, zeros minus poles.

  • The search passes if the firing cells, grown by one cell, wind the same.
  • Otherwise each dark cell is checked by its own winding. It holds no firing cell, so a nonzero winding is a missed locus: the cell is searched again, and fires if it still winds at zres.
  • If the labels (below) still differ from the box's count, the dark cells within a cell of a group are searched again. The remainder is deficit.
Code
# Eight zeros inside one root cell, before and after the count is checked.
c = 0.3 + 0.2im
f = z -> (z - c)^8 - 0.1^8
alg = ArgumentPrinciple(zres=0.02, minsep=0.36)
memo, cells, dark = _search(f, BOX, alg, map)
fig = Figure(; size=(720, 380))
for (i, title) in enumerate(("search", "after the certificate"))
    i == 2 && _certify!(memo, cells, dark, alg.zres)
    local ax = Axis(fig[1, i]; aspect=DataAspect(), xlabel="Re z", ylabel="Im z", title="$title: $(length(cells)) firing cells")
    phase!(ax, f, BOX...)
    mesh!(ax, memo, cells, dark)
end

Eight zeros on a circle 0.1 across, inside one root cell (minsep = 0.36). The search finds some; the box counts 8, so the dark cells that wind are searched again.

Labels

  • Firing cells at zres that share an edge or a corner form a group.
  • A group's label is the winding of f around its outline: its cells grown by one cell and clipped to the box. Separate groups are at least two cells apart, so an outline holds no other group's cells.
  • Outlines are integrated adaptively: each edge is bisected until every step turns the phase by less than π/2 and changes |f| by less than 2×.
  • A group is mixed if its vote may hide loci of both kinds, e.g. a simple zero beside a double pole votes −1. By the maximum modulus principle, a cell corner with |f| above the outline's maximum implies a pole inside, below its minimum a zero; both means mixed.
Code
zs, ps = [0.10 + 0.07im, -0.2 - 0.15im], [0.27 + 0.12im]
f = z -> (z - zs[1]) * (z - zs[2])^2 / (z - ps[1])
memo, cells, _ = _search(f, BOX, ArgumentPrinciple(zres=0.05, minsep=0.18), map)
fig = Figure(; size=(500, 380))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1]; aspect=DataAspect(), xlabel="Re z", ylabel="Im z")
phase!(ax, f, -0.42 - 0.36im, 0.5 + 0.32im)
for g in _group(cells)
    o = outline(memo, g)
    poly!(ax, rect.(Ref(memo.lat), g); color=(signcolor(o.w), 0.55), strokecolor=:black, strokewidth=0.5)
    linesegments!(ax, o.segs; color=:black, linewidth=2.5)
    scatter!(ax, o.pts; color=:white, strokecolor=:black, strokewidth=1, markersize=6)
    text!(ax, minimum(first, o.segs), maximum(last, o.segs); text="w = $(signed(o.w))", fontsize=16, font=:bold, align=(:left, :bottom))
end
loci!(ax, zs, ps; markersize=10)

Groups of firing cells (filled), their outlines, and the points each vote evaluated, for a simple zero, a simple pole and a double zero at zres = 0.05.

Escalation

  • A group that is mixed, votes 0, or cannot be read is refined one level below zres, regrouped and labelled again, up to zoom levels. At the last level a nonzero vote stands, mixed or not.
  • A group that votes 0 or cannot be read, and has nothing firing one level finer, is dropped: its cells fired on a misread phase (a locus just outside the box, a phase turning faster than a cell), not on a locus.
  • A group still unlabelled at the last level is reported unresolved: a zero and a pole closer than a last-level cell.
  • Each labelled group is reported at the mean of its cell centres, then polished.
Code
# One row per function, one panel per level until every group is labelled.
rows = [
    (; f=z -> (z - 0.985 - 0.011im) / (z - 1.012 - 0.006im), box=(0 - 0.4im, 2 + 0.4im), zres=0.05, minsep=0.135,
        zeros=[0.985 + 0.011im], poles=[1.012 + 0.006im], view=(0.94 - 0.04im, 1.06 + 0.06im)),
    (; f=z -> (z - 0.52 - 0.33im) / (z - 0.52 - 0.33im - 0.02cispi(0.25))^2, box=BOX, zres=0.02, minsep=0.18,
        zeros=[0.52 + 0.33im], poles=[0.52 + 0.33im + 0.02cispi(0.25)], view=(0.488 + 0.305im, 0.572 + 0.375im)),
]
fig = Figure(; size=(580, 480))
for (r, (; f, box, zres, minsep, zeros, poles, view)) in enumerate(rows)
    local memo, cells = _search(f, box, ArgumentPrinciple(; zres, minsep), map)
    undecided(g) = (o = outline(memo, g); o.mixed || something(o.w, 0) == 0)
    levels = [_group(cells)]
    while any(undecided, levels[end]) && length(levels) < 3
        push!(levels, reduce(vcat, [undecided(g) ? _group(_deepen!(memo, g)) : [g] for g in levels[end]]))
    end
    for (i, groups) in enumerate(levels)
        local ax = Axis(fig[r, i]; aspect=DataAspect(), title=i == 1 ? "zres" : "zres / $(2^(i - 1))")
        hidedecorations!(ax)
        phase!(ax, f, view...)
        for g in groups
            o = outline(memo, g)
            poly!(ax, rect.(Ref(memo.lat), g); color=(signcolor(o.w), 0.6), strokecolor=:black, strokewidth=0.5)
            linesegments!(ax, o.segs; color=:black, linewidth=2.5)
            left = something(o.w, 0) ≥ 0    # opposite corners, so neighbouring labels stay apart
            text!(ax, (left ? minimum : maximum)(first, o.segs), maximum(last, o.segs); text="w = $(signed(o.w))" * (o.mixed ? ", mixed" : ""),
                fontsize=15, font=:bold, align=(left ? :left : :right, :bottom))
        end
        loci!(ax, zeros, poles; markersize=10)
    end
end

Top: a zero (○) and a pole (×) 0.027 apart at zres = 0.05 form one group voting 0; two levels finer they split. Bottom: a zero beside a double pole 0.02 apart at zres = 0.02 votes −1, mixed; one level finer they split. Cells are green, red or grey as their group votes positive, negative or 0.

What can go wrong

CaseEffectResult
Zero–pole pair much closer than minsepcancels on the walk and in the box's count; its phase fades within a few pair-widthsmissed, unflagged
Simple locus with a second one hugging the same edgecan slip past walk, guard and certificatefused into its partner's label, or flagged by deficit
High-order loci within a few cells of each otherrarely, one is missed beside the otherflagged by deficit
Zero and pole of different orders closer than about a cell (two for order 3)not mixedone locus of their net winding, unflagged
